title: Show available board games at a volunteer lending desk
description: A desk volunteer records loans on paper. Visitors need a list of games that can be borrowed now. The requested first version shows game title and available copy count. Only desk volunteers may change loan records. Visitor reservations and online payments are explicitly out of scope.

comments.text: Availability means total owned copies minus active loans. A returned loan stops reducing availability.
How lost copies affect total owned copies is still undecided. Do not assume a lost-item rule.
